inference: IOS does not detect internal PoE hardware or usable PoE budget. Missing daughter card is a leading possibility; physical absence is not verified. Prototype/controller detection and supply-path faults remain alternatives. A green actual PoE LED would be a material discrepancy, not grounds to ignore the diagnostic.

sources.section: Power specifications for C8235-G2 and LED Indicators
sources.finding: Cisco says the internal PoE daughter card comes with initial PoE ordering and is not field-upgradeable. Total PoE budget up to 120 W. PoE indicator is below S and shown as lightning bolt; green indicates PoE supply connected.
Standard adapter PWR-CC2-66WAC; optional PWR-CC1-230WAC has +12 V system and -54 V PoE outputs.
